rules.name: Combined Arms (British or American)
rules.description:
The Chinese worked closely with the British and American forces that trained and supplied them. An American or British battlegroup may take up to a quarter (25%) of its points total from the Chinese Expeditionary Force army list. These units can only be selected from Infantry, Tanks, or Artillery front-line assets. Any Chinese infantry taken count towards the minimum infantry required.

Conversely, a Chinese battlegroup may take up to a quarter (25%) of its points total from a American or British army list. These units can only be selected from Infantry, Tanks, or Artillery front-line assets. Any American or British infantry count towards the minimum infantry required.

rules.name: Captured Vehicle
rules.description: A single captured enemy tank can be included as a Specialist Unit. It must be taken from the Tank Section of the Army List you will be fighting against. This tank cannot be rated as Restricted or Unique in that list. The captured vehicle cannot be resupplied during the game.
